verdict.rationale: Hardware- and task-aware model recommendation is a fair question for a local LLM runtime like llamafile, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only a pre-built llamafiles download page and a static docs note naming good multimodal candidates. Nothing shows an AI assistant that checks the user's hardware or task and recommends a model before download.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can rely on an AI assistant to recommend which local model best fits my hardware and task before I download it
